papers.title: Efficient proximity labeling in living cells and organisms with TurboID
papers.Ting_relationship: Alice Y. Ting is a senior author; directly from her research team.
papers.enzyme_class: Biotin ligase used for proximity labeling
papers.variant_types_high_level: Published evolved full-length ligases and a smaller deletion-bearing variant, compared with earlier ligases and intermediate variants.

recommended_evidence_panels.measured_quantity: Promiscuous biotinylation band intensity, normalized to enzyme-expression signal; separate early and later labeling-time comparisons.
recommended_evidence_panels.what_it_supports: Published variants differ in cellular labeling activity and background. This measures the combined variant under stated conditions, not isolated causality for every substitution.
recommended_evidence_panels.data_status: Caption and normalization checked in primary full-text XML. Exact bar heights have not been transcribed.

recommended_evidence_panels.measured_quantity: Expression-normalized cellular labeling across intermediate and final ligase variants.
recommended_evidence_panels.what_it_supports: Comparison of measured phenotypes along the reported variant series.

papers.evidence_question_template: Given expression-normalized labeling results with and without added biotin, which published variant best meets a stated balance between labeling activity and background?
student_required_information: Variant labels or parent/variant sequences and verified differences
papers.sequence_only_limit: Anonymous sequence alone does not establish the measured activity or background.

correction.scope: Corrects copying errors in Supplementary Tables 2–7; use current corrected files for proteomic questions.

papers.title: Directed evolution of APEX2 for electron microscopy and proximity labeling
papers.Ting_relationship: Alice Y. Ting is a senior author; directly from her research team.
papers.variant_types_high_level: Published parent, evolved single-substitution variant, combination variant and dimeric comparator.

recommended_evidence_panels.measured_quantity: Initial guaiacol-oxidation rate versus peroxide concentration, under two substrate conditions.
recommended_evidence_panels.what_it_supports: The evolved enzyme retains activity over a different peroxide range; resistance to inhibition is condition-dependent.
recommended_evidence_panels.data_status: Corrected primary author PDF Results and full Figure 2 caption inspected. Numerical curve values have not been transcribed.

recommended_evidence_panels.measured_quantity: Cellular biotinylation fluorescence and separate enzyme-expression staining.
recommended_evidence_panels.what_it_supports: Cellular labeling differences; this readout alone is not a purified-enzyme catalytic constant.

papers.evidence_question_template: Given matched parent/variant activity curves, which interpretation distinguishes improved peroxide tolerance from an unconditional increase in catalytic activity?
student_required_information: Parent/variant identity or verified sequence difference
Measured curves or a faithfully extracted data table
papers.sequence_only_limit: A substitution position does not by itself prove the direction or size of an activity change.

correction.scope: December 2014 correction fixes Figure 2a symbols and obscured Figure 2e ordinate labels; use the corrected version.

papers.title: Directed Evolution of Split APEX2 Peroxidase
papers.Ting_relationship: Alice Ting is a senior author; directly from her research team.
papers.variant_types_high_level: Published sequentially evolved fragment variants, paired with a common partner fragment, compared with the parent pair and full-length enzyme.

recommended_evidence_panels.measured_quantity: DAB staining, proximity-labeling fluorescence and biotinylation blot signal; interaction-induced and control conditions, with expression controls.
recommended_evidence_panels.what_it_supports: Activity and interaction-dependence can change differently during variant evolution.
recommended_evidence_panels.data_status: Primary figure captions and Results inspected. Images and blot signals are comparative evidence; no new numerical values inferred.

recommended_evidence_panels.measured_quantity: Flow-cytometry activity/expression distributions and reported quadrant fractions.
recommended_evidence_panels.what_it_supports: Variant activity and background across published generations.

papers.evidence_question_template: Given induced and uninduced labeling plus expression controls, which published variant improves conditional activity without merely increasing background?
papers.sequence_only_limit: Fragment identity alone does not establish reconstitution activity or background.

correction.scope: Correction replaces duplicated images in Figure 1e and Figure 2b with independently repeated experiments. Use replacement panels; Figure 3 is not identified as corrected.
